CommunityApplications.Profile: footsys is a football manager / career simulator that runs entirely in your browser. The app is fully client-side: all game data and images are bundled, with no backend, no database and no network access at runtime. The container simply serves a static site via nginx. This repository provides the self-host Docker template for footsys. Support and issues: https://github.com/ni-kore/footsys/issues
